name: 视频阴影一致性
description: 分析视频帧中阴影的方向、强度和时间一致性。
useCase: Detecting manipulated videos through 阴影 behavior 异常
mechanism: Tracks 阴影 positions, directions, and intensities 跨 frames relative to light sources. In manipulated videos, 阴影s may not follow consistent physics - changing direction unnaturally, disappearing or appearing without cause, or exhibiting temporal flickering.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 72-85% on composited and manipulated videos
source: Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2010) - Exposing Digital Forgeries from 3-D Lighting Environments, ICIP
algorithm: Shadow Detection + Light Source Estimation + Temporal Consistency Verification
parameters: Shadow 阈值: 自适应, Light estimation: spherical harmonics, Consistency window: 20 frames
strengths:
• 基于物理定律的阴影验证
• AI生成难以维持阴影一致性
• 检测光源方向矛盾
• 与其他取证方法互补
limitations:
• 阴天或漫射光照下阴影微弱
• 无阴影的室内场景效果有限
• 多光源环境分析复杂化
• 动态光照场景精度降低

references.title: Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2010). Exposing Digital Forgeries from 3-D Lighting Environments. ICIP.
Zhang, W. et al. (2019). Detecting and Simulating Artifacts in GAN Fake Images. WIFS.
Peng, B. et al. (2017). Optimized 3D Lighting Environment Estimation. IEEE TIP.
